description: Open book, white pages with rows of raised Braille dots (small ink circles with a cream highlight), postal-red cover edge, 3 px ink outline; 520x340. Recurring picture of Parts 1-3.
Closed hardback, sand #f3ead6 cover with postal-red spine, a white luggage tag on a string with a blank face the scene letters 'Gyan Post'; 360x440, 3 px ink. Recurring picture of Parts 4-6.
Six flat ink icons, each its own group: #plate (embossed plate with dot rows), #record (sound record), #disc, #film (reel), #tape (cassette), #wire (wire spool); kit colours, 3 px ink; 1500x260.
Small columned building, sand walls, postal-red roof line, blank white sign plate (x60-300, y40-100) for the scene's words; 360x320, 3 px ink.
Horizontal rolled document seen three-quarter: cream body (#body), round end on the left drawn as an ellipse (#end) so a diameter line can cross it; 760x260, 3 px ink.
Sand paper band wrapped round a book (#band), both short ends open with the book (#book) visible and able to slide out; 520x300, 3 px ink.
Perforated white postage stamp, postal-red frame, small ink post-horn motif, blank value corner; 200x240.
Postal-order-like slip: cream paper, red border, a rupee mark, blank rules and a counterfoil edge; no real document copied; 420x240.
Folded white letter with loose handwriting squiggle lines in ink, no readable words; 360x460.
Flat ink plane icon, white body with a blue #2456a6 stripe; 360x200.
Ink globe: cream sea, sand land, one meridian arc; 320x320.
Simple ink house with a door and a blank number plate, sand walls, red roof; 300x300.
